settings.title: Settings
settings.invalid: Some values are out of range or incomplete. Nothing was saved.

ai.baseUrlHint: The address of the server's OpenAI-compatible API, for example http://localhost:1234/v1 for LM Studio.
ai.contextSizeHintOllamaLimit: How much text the app asks Ollama to read in one request. 32k fits everything the app sends: a CV, a posting or a careers page with the answer. More only takes more memory; less can leave long careers pages unread. This model takes up to {{limit}} tokens. Ollama's own context setting does not limit it.
ai.contextSizeHint: How many tokens the server reads in one request; its own settings say so. The app uses it to spot texts that are too long: a longer posting is not scored and a longer CV is flagged, instead of being cut without notice.

test.hint: Saves your changes, then tests the provider, model and key.

reasons.not-configured: the model, key or base URL is missing
reasons.invalid-key: the provider rejected the API key
reasons.model-not-found: the provider does not know this model
reasons.rate-limited: the provider is rate limiting requests or the account is out of credit
reasons.unreachable: the provider could not be reached
reasons.timeout: the model did not answer in time; a model on this computer may need a smaller context or a lighter model
reasons.invalid-output: the provider answered in an unexpected format
reasons.engine-unavailable: the AI worker is not running

ai.contextSizeHintOllama: How much text the app asks Ollama to read in one request. 32k fits everything the app sends: a CV, a posting or a careers page with the answer. More only takes more memory; less can leave long careers pages unread. Ollama's own context setting does not limit it.

help.anthropic: Claude models, in the cloud. Create an API key in the Anthropic Console and paste it below. Your CV and job texts are sent to Anthropic.
help.openai: GPT models, in the cloud. Create an API key on the OpenAI platform and paste it below. Your CV and job texts are sent to OpenAI.
help.gemini: Gemini models, in the cloud. Create an API key in Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com) and paste it below. Your CV and job texts are sent to Google; on the free tier Google may use them to improve its models.
help.ollama: Runs on this computer: no key, and nothing leaves your machine. Install Ollama from ollama.com, open it, then download a model in the terminal, for example: ollama pull {{example}}
help.openaiCompatible: Any server with an OpenAI-compatible API, such as LM Studio or vLLM. Enter its address and, if it asks for one, a key.

ollama.addressHint: Ollama's default address. Change it only if you started Ollama on another port.
ollama.noUrl: Enter Ollama's address to see the installed models.
ollama.empty: Ollama is running but has no models. Download one in the terminal, for example: ollama pull {{example}}, then refresh the list.

reasons.not-local: The model list is read only from Ollama on this computer. Use a localhost address.
reasons.unreachable: Ollama is not answering at {{url}}. Open the Ollama app, then refresh the list.
reasons.invalid-response: The server at {{url}} is not Ollama. Choose "Other OpenAI-compatible server" for it.

ai.geminiModelHint: The model name as Google AI Studio shows it, starting with gemini-. A Flash model is fast and cheap for scoring many jobs.

models.empty: The provider listed no models. Type the model name instead.
models.noUrl: Enter the server address to see its models.

reasons.no-key: Save your API key above to see the available models.
reasons.invalid-key: The provider rejected the saved key. Check it and save it again.
reasons.invalid-key-server: The server asks for a key. Save the address and the key in the settings, then refresh the list.
reasons.unreachable: The provider is not answering. Check your connection, then refresh the list.
reasons.unreachable-server: The server at {{url}} is not answering. Start it, then refresh the list.
reasons.invalid-response: This server does not list its models. Type the model name instead.
reasons.not-local: The model list is read only from this computer.
reasons.engine-unavailable: The AI worker is not running, so the models cannot be listed. Restart the app.

search.intro: The app looks on the web for the job boards of companies hiring for the roles in your profile, and when you search on the Sources page. Pick the service it searches with: DuckDuckGo needs nothing; the others are more reliable and have a free plan with a key.
search.duckduckgoHint: Free and without a key. Enough to start, but it sometimes blocks automated searches.
search.needsKey: Paste a key, or this service is skipped.

updates.hint: Looks at GitHub Releases for a newer version. Nothing else is sent.

secrets.keyFailed: The key could not be saved.
secrets.removeFailed: The key could not be removed.
secrets.storagePlain: Keys are kept in the app's data folder on this computer, without the system keychain.
